sentences.english: The husband buys a big fish.
The small dog sees the big fish.
The small dog seizes the big fish.
The husband sees the small dog.
And so the husband calls the wife.
The wife hears her own husband's clear voice.
sentences.latin: Uxor mariti sui vocem claram audit.

sentences.english: The husband tells his own wife true words.
sentences.latin: Maritus uxori suae verba vera dicit.

sentences.english: The husband gives the big fish to his own wife.
sentences.latin: Maritus piscem magnum uxori suae dat.

sentences.english: The small, lucky, and brave dog is praised.
sentences.latin: Canis parvus, felix et fortis laudatur.

sentences.english: But the husband envies the lucky and brave dog.
sentences.latin: Sed maritus cani felici et forti invidet.

sentences.english: The wife loves the small, wise dog with great spirit.
sentences.latin: Uxor canem parvum et sapientem magno animo amat.

sentences.english: The big fish is given to the whole family by the happy wife.
sentences.latin: Piscis magnus ab uxore felici omni familiae datur.

sentences.english: With a heavy spirit, the husband envies the brave and loyal dog.
sentences.latin: Maritus animo gravi cani forti et fideli invidet.

sentences.english: And so the whole family praises the small, loyal dog with great spirit.
sentences.latin: Itaque omnis familia canem parvum et fidelem magno animo laudat.

sentences.english: For the small, wise dog unites the whole family.
sentences.latin: Nam canis parvus et sapiens omnem familiam iungit.
